evidence: Carries the Validation label and refactors block storage writes, prune bookkeeping, and flush failure retry handling into BlockManager under node/blockstorage.
rationale: Adds prune locks and target pruning mechanisms while moving block storage writes and prune bookkeeping into BlockManager. This primarily serves kernel API consumers (addressing issue #35627) and mixes kernel API surface changes with core block storage refactoring, making it worthwhile work for kernel modularity that does not alter consensus or core node validation performance.
